dashboard.spec/description: Health check, repair and backup status of the clusters managed by Scylla Manager.

spec.name: sm_cluster
spec.label: Manager cluster
spec.description: The cluster as registered in Scylla Manager. ScyllaDB Cloud also registers Manager's own backend, the single-node Scylla cluster that stores its state, as a separate entry named 'sm-backend'.

spec.name: repair_task
spec.label: Repair task

spec.query: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

spec.definition: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

spec.name: backup_task
spec.label: Backup task

spec.query: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

spec.definition: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

spec.expr: 100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"})

100 * (node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"} - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"}) / clamp_min(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|"}, 1)
100 * (1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="scylla_manager", cluster=~"$cluster|", mode="idle"}[5m])))

rows.title: Scylla Manager -> cluster nodes connectivity health check

spec.expr: count(scylla_manager_healthcheck_cql_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"} != 1) or vector(0)
count(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_cql_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) != 1) or vector(0)
count(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"} != 1) or vector(0)
count(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) != 1) or vector(0)
count(scylla_manager_healthcheck_alternator_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"} != 1) or vector(0)
count(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_alternator_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) != 1) or vector(0)

spec.title: Nodes not healthy for the whole range

spec.expr: label_replace(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_cql_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -1 unless on(cluster, dc, rack, host) (min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -2), "protocol", "CQL", "", "") or label_replace(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -1, "protocol", "REST", "", "") or label_replace(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_alternator_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -1 unless on(cluster, dc, rack, host) (min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -2), "protocol", "Alternator", "", "") or label_replace(min_over_time(scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}[$__range]) == -2, "protocol", "Agent", "", "")
scylla_manager_healthcheck_cql_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}
scylla_manager_healthcheck_rest_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}
scylla_manager_healthcheck_alternator_status{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", dc=~"$dc", host=~"$host"}

spec.title: Repair tasks
spec.description: Name, Type and Cron are the task's current configuration. The remaining properties are the ones the most recent run started with, so they stay unchanged until the task runs again and are empty until it runs for the first time after Scylla Manager restarts.

spec.expr: max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))

(max by (task) ((time() - scylla_manager_scheduler_last_success{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"}) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))) or (max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}) * 0 + 99999999)

max by (task) ((scylla_manager_repair_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} or avg by (cluster, task) (scylla_manager_tablet_repair_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"})) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))
max by (task, name, cron, type) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"})

max by (task, keyspace, dc, keyspace_replication, incremental_mode, host, fail_fast, ignore_down_hosts) (scylla_manager_repair_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))

(max by (task) ((scylla_manager_repair_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} or avg by (cluster, task) (scylla_manager_tablet_repair_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"})) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} == 1)) or max by (task) ((scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} != 1) - 10)) * on(task) group_left(name) (topk(1, scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}) by (task))

rows.title: Time since the last successful repair

spec.title: Time since the last successful repair

spec.expr: time() - max by (name) (scylla_manager_scheduler_last_success{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} * on(task) group_left(name) (topk(1, scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}) by (task)))

spec.title: Backup tasks
spec.description: Name and Cron are the task's current configuration. The remaining properties are the ones the most recent run started with, so they stay unchanged until the task runs again and are empty until it runs for the first time after Scylla Manager restarts.

spec.expr: max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}))

(max by (task) ((time() - scylla_manager_scheduler_last_success{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup"}) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}))) or (max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}) * 0 + 99999999)

max by (task) (scylla_manager_backup_task_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}))
max by (task, name, cron) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"})

max by (task, keyspace, dc, location, retention, retention_days, method, purge_only, skip_schema, retention_lock_mode) (scylla_manager_backup_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}))

(max by (task) (scylla_manager_backup_task_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup"} == 1)) or max by (task) ((scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup"} != 1) - 10)) * on(task) group_left(name) (topk(1, scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type="backup", name=~"$backup_task"}) by (task))
